data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), before one of your **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** units Consolidates.

**Target:** That **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** unit.

**Effect:** The unit's models can make [Consolidation moves](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move) of as much as 6" rather than 3", for the rest of the phase. They can do so only if the unit ends those moves in range of an Acquisition objective marker of yours.

**Restrictions:** The unit cannot be targeted while any enemy unit is within 3" of it.
